name: Poles and substation steel
definition: Welded steel poles and pole-type structures made in a US plant from formed plate or tube, where these structures are a named product line or core stated capability of the plant: tapered and multi-sided transmission and distribution poles; substation structures (dead-end, bus-support and equipment-support steel); and lighting, high-mast, traffic-signal, sign-support and telecom monopole structures. Out of scope (recorded as excluded with the reason, not dropped): bolted lattice towers (angle-member transmission and self-supporting telecom towers), concrete, wood and fiberglass/composite poles, wind towers, plants that only galvanize, coat, distribute or install, and general fabricators that build such structures only as occasional custom jobs. Aluminum-first pole plants are kept and noted.
est_us_plants: approx. 50-90 (inferred; floor of named plants from Valmont, Arcosa, Nucor, Nello, Millerbernd, Falcon)
weld_intensity: High: every pole has seam welds (often SAW) plus base plates, flanges, arms, vangs and hardware welded by GMAW/FCAW
part_size_fit: Cell: pole sections up to 60 ft and 48-150 in fit the 2026 cell (60 ft x 15 ft, 55,000 lb); older AW3 limit (72 in dia, 65 ft, 10,500 lb) fits distribution, lighting, traffic and telecom poles but not large transmission bases
part_variety: High: engineered-to-order structures with part-to-part variation and imperfect fit-up
hiring_pain: High: Valmont and Arcosa 10-Ks cite welder shortages; open MIG welder postings at Valmont
demand_outlook: Strong: Valmont NA Utility +23% (Q3 2026), Arcosa converting a wind plant to utility structures, Nucor building three pole plants and a $105M expansion
path_presence: 4 confirmed: Millerbernd (production), Nello (FAT passed), TransAmerican Power Products (roster; plants in Mexico), Valmont (2021 quote)
fit_test: pass: mostly welded steel; GMAW/FCAW main process for connections and attachments (long seams often SAW); sections fit a cell; engineered-to-order variety
reason: Partial pending the done checkpoint (2026-11-13). 118 plants found; 88 included (81 profiled, 7 base), 30 excluded. Profiled tiers High 9 / Medium 35 / Low 37. Fact error rate by round: 11.8%, 19.4%, 8.2%, 8.9% (round 4 confirming). Miss rate 7.8% against the list auditors (lower bound); 34.1% finder first pass against all plants verified to date, all now in the ledger. Figures: ledger/audit/summary.json.
